title: 'Breaking our chains': Syrian survivor recounts years of torture, freedom from Sednaya prison after regime’s fall
content: Former detainee says prisoners were ‘stacked on top of each other,’ some suffocated in their sleep, diseases were rampant

title: UN chief 'strongly' condemns Israel for forced entry into UNRWA compound in East Jerusalem
content: 'This compound remains United Nations premises and is inviolable and immune from any other form of interference,' says Antonio Guterres

title: Syrian foreign minister reveals meeting with Russians hours before Assad’s fall
content: Asaad al-Shaibani recounts last-minute talks with Moscow during battles, aiming to secure Syria’s transition and future interests

title: Countries worldwide boost ties with Syria since Assad's fall, except Israel and Iran
content: 1 year after Assad’s fall, countries from the Middle East, Europe and beyond restore diplomatic ties with Damascus

title: Sisi meets Libyan commander Haftar, reaffirms Egypt’s support for Libya’s territorial unity
content: Egyptian president reaffirms his country’s backing for all initiatives aimed at resolving the Libyan crisis, especially those seeking to hold simultaneous presidential and parliamentary elections

title: Arab states congratulate Syrian president on Liberation Day marking fall of Assad regime
content: Leaders from Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Jordan, Lebanon send messages to President Ahmad al-Sharaa as Syrians mark 1st anniversary of Assad’s ouster

title: Belgium regrets Israeli raid on UNRWA compound in East Jerusalem, says 'UN are not terrorists'
content: Foreign minister stresses that UN buildings are protected under international law

title: Slovenia condemns Israel for forced entry into UNRWA compound in East Jerusalem
content: Ljubljana says Israel’s actions, including seizing property and removing a UN flag, violate inviolability of UN premises and breach international legal obligations

title: Sharaa vows transitional justice as Syria marks 1st anniversary of Assad’s fall
content: President Ahmad al-Sharaa says accountability, victims’ rights and truth-seeking are central pillars of Syria’s rebuilding process

title: A.I. Videos Have Flooded Social Media. No One Was Ready.
content: Apps like OpenAI’s Sora are fooling millions of users into thinking A.I. videos are real, even when they include warning labels.

title: Trump Stands in the Middle as Netflix and Paramount Vie for a Megadeal
content: The president has shattered norms by pledging to “be involved” in the regulatory fate of a transaction that could reshape the news and entertainment industries.

title: Jared Kushner Is Part of Paramount’s Bid for Warner Bros. Discovery
content: Mr. Kushner’s private equity fund is one of the many groups helping Paramount mount a hostile bid to buy the group, whose holdings include CNN.

title: Trump Giving Farmers $12 Billion to Blunt Trade War Fallout
content: Federal relief money comes after China boycotted American farm products in retaliation for U.S. tariffs.

title: How Japan Built a Rare-Earth Supply Chain Without China
content: The 15-year effort by Japan is a model for countries now scrambling to reduce their dependence on Beijing’s critical metals.

title: Planes, Trade and Nuclear Energy: Supreme Court Weighs Fate of Independent Regulators
content: The court heard arguments Monday in a case that could determine the independence of agencies like the National Transportation Safety Board and the Nuclear Regulatory Commission.
